title: Why Government Bond Yields Are Rising and Causing Alarm
title_cn: 为什么政府债券收益率上升并引起警惕
summary: Government borrowing costs have been surging around the world as investors demand more compensation to entice them to hold longer-maturity debt. Yields on 30-year Japanese government bonds are near all-time highs at 4.19%, while 30-year UK government bond yields are at their highest since 1998. A Bloomberg gauge tracking government debt across the Group of Seven countries now yields its highest on average since September 2000.

title: Stocks, Bonds Fall as Oil Jumps on US-Iran Jitters: Markets Wrap
title_cn: 由于美国和伊朗的紧张局势导致石油价格上涨，股市和债券下跌：市场结束

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 1
title_cn: 9 月 1 日最新石油市场新闻和分析

title: Dell, HP Enterprise Need Earnings to Validate Record Stock Runs

summary: Artificial intelligence fever is powering Dell Technologies Inc. and Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. to their best years in the stock market.

title: US Strikes Targets in Iran Around Strait of Hormuz
title_cn: 美国空袭霍尔木兹海峡周边伊朗目标
summary: The US launched strikes against Iranian targets around the Strait of Hormuz, following Iran's attacks on commercial shipping and American forces in the region. Oil prices are spiking on the news. Tyler Kendall reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nasdaq 100 Drops as Traders Assess Oil Spike, Bond Jitters
title_cn: 交易员评估油价飙升和债券紧张情绪，纳斯达克 100 指数下跌
summary: The Nasdaq 100 Index is retreating on Tuesday after coming off session lows, as investors weigh the effects of rising bond yields and higher oil prices on the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook.

title: Bond Slide Spreads to Emerging Markets on Fed Rate-Hike Bets
title_cn: 美联储加息押注导致债券滑坡蔓延至新兴市场
summary: A global bond selloff spread to emerging markets as investors dumped the riskier debt on expectations that the Federal Reserve will increase US interest rates later this month.

title: Global Bond Rout Sends Yields Soaring | Open Interest 9/1/2026
title_cn: 全球债券溃败导致收益率飙升|未平仓合约 9/1/2026
summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Global bonds tumble as yields surge to levels not seen since 2008, with soaring oil and renewed Middle East tensions fueling the selloff. Plus, a new era at Apple as John Ternus takes the reins. We’ll dig into Bobby Jain’s Millennium deal and the private-markets shakeout with Achilles Global Management CIO Sachin Khajuria. Plus, David Layton, the CEO of the Partners Group joins us to push back on concerns his move to CIO signals trouble. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fortress’s Burton Says Rates Still Poised to Go Higher
title_cn: Fortress 的伯顿表示利率仍将走高
summary: Global bonds slumped as rising oil prices fueled inflation fears and bets on Fed rate hikes. Fortress Chief Strategist Elizabeth Burton says rates are still poised to go higher, arguing the underlying problem won’t be fixed without a fiscal response. She speaks on Bloomberg Open Interest. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Senegal Says Will Rework Debt as it Reaches New IMF Deal
title_cn: 塞内加尔表示将在达成新的国际货币基金组织协议时重新调整债务
summary: Senegal’s eurobonds fell on Tuesday after the government said it will move forward with a “debt treatment” under the Group of 20’s Common Framework and agreed a new $2.2 billion financing program with the International Monetary Fund.

title: Bond Market Selloff: Are Surging Yields a Threat to the Global Stock Rally?
title_cn: 债券市场抛售：收益率飙升是否对全球股市上涨构成威胁？
summary: In equity markets, the myth goes that the only way is up. That perception has gained traction as global stock prices have largely ignored the selloff in bond markets. Yields on long-dated government debt have surged to near two-decade highs as investors worry about whether inflation and fiscal deficits can be tamed, and as sovereign bonds compete with an AI-fueled corporate borrowing boom.

title: Oil Extends Advance as US-Iran Escalation Revives Hormuz Risks
title_cn: 美伊局势升级重燃霍尔木兹风险，油价上涨
summary:
Oil rose for a second session as fresh hostilities between the US and Iran raised concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz, where crude carriers were hit by projectiles.
Leslie Palti-Guzman, Founder at Energy Vista, discusses the outlook for global energy as conflict in the Middle East continues to disrupt flow. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Peru Inflation Just Tops Estimate to Hit Fastest Since 2023
title_cn: 秘鲁通胀刚刚超过预期，创 2023 年以来最快
summary: Inflation in Peru’s capital accelerated slightly more than expected in August, hitting the fastest pace in almost three years, pressured by housing and utilities including electricity and gas.

title: Italy’s League Faces Northern Split as National Future Surges
title_cn: 随着国家未来的发展，意大利联赛面临北部分裂
summary: A group of former members of Italy’s League has called for a revival of the party’s northern federal roots, openly challenging leader Matteo Salvini and adding to the pressure on him from the rise of the ultra-nationalist National Future party.

title: Uruguay acelera desdolarización con nuevos fondos Money Market

summary: Wells Fargo & Co. is the second bank to turn cautious on US stocks this week as the market heads into what is historically the worst month on the calendar for equities and upcoming midterm elections add to uncertainty surrounding the artificial-intelligence trade.

title: EU Considers Front-Loading Ukraine Loan as Funding Shortage Hits
title_cn: 由于资金短缺，欧盟考虑提前向乌克兰提供贷款
summary: European Union member states are considering accelerating payments from the bloc’s €90 billion ($104 billion) loan to Ukraine as Kyiv faces a funding crunch, the bloc’s rotating presidency said.

title: US-Iran Tensions High After Strikes on Two Tankers in Hormuz
title_cn: 霍尔木兹两艘油轮遭到袭击后，美伊关系紧张
summary: US-Iran tensions over the Strait of Hormuz heightened after a flurry of military strikes at the start of the week, with neither side prepared to cede ground over the crucial waterway.

title: Partners Group CEO Rejects Redemption Concerns
title_cn: 合众集团首席执行官否认赎回担忧
summary: Partners Group CEO David Layton joined Bloomberg Open Interest to push back on concerns that his move to CIO signals trouble at the private-markets giant. He explains why the leadership shake-up isn’t tied to redemption pressure, says the firm is gaining fundraising share despite an industry slowdown, and reveals why elevated evergreen-fund redemptions could continue for another 12 to 18 months. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Redwire is Growing Strawberries in Space
title_cn: Redwire 在太空种植草莓
summary: Redwire CEO Peter Cannito joins Bloomberg Open Interest to break down the next phase of the space economy—from orbital data centers and cheaper space manufacturing to the growing US, China space race. He also explains why falling transportation costs, SpaceX partnerships and even space agriculture could create major new commercial opportunities. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: LSE to Roll Out Tokenized Stocks
title_cn: 伦敦证券交易所将推出代币化股票
summary:
Amira Valliani, head of payments growth at The Solana Foundation, joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." The London Stock Exchange is planning to launch tokenized stocks, backed by shares of London-listed companies, as it looks to further embrace digital assets.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Hyperliquid In Talks For US Market Entry
title_cn: Hyperliquid正在洽谈进入美国市场
summary: Bloomberg Intelligence's Dushyant Shahrawat joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Hyperliquid is in advanced talks to bring its perpetual futures to US traders through Kraken’s parent company Payward, just weeks after President Trump said his administration was working to bring the fast-growing platform into the US. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple’s 2,300% Rally Under Tim Cook
title_cn: 蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 领导下苹果股价上涨 2,300%
summary: Tim Cook hands the reins of Apple to John Ternus after a 15-year run that transformed the company into a $4.6 trillion giant and delivered a nearly 2,300% stock gain. Bloomberg’s Ryan Vlastelica looks at Cook’s market legacy and why Apple shares are increasingly moving against the broader AI trade. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nestle Sells Vitamins Business to PE Buyer for $1 Billion
title_cn: 雀巢以 10 亿美元向私募股权买家出售维生素业务
summary: Nestle SA plans to sell its mainstream vitamins and supplements business to US private equity firm Yellow Wood Partners for $1 billion as Chief Executive Officer Philipp Navratil tries to streamline and turn around the Swiss foodmaker.

title: Sold 'Minuscule' Amount of Bitcoin: Strategy CEO
title_cn: Strategy CEO：出售“极少”数量的比特币
summary: Phong Le, CEO and president of Strategy, joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Strategy resumed Bitcoin purchases after a 10-week pause, returning to its signature accumulation strategy after the crypto bear market pressured its shares, weakened confidence in the financing model and prompted a balance-sheet overhaul. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Dyson Unveils AI-Powered Toothbrush With Built-In Camera
title_cn: 戴森推出内置摄像头的人工智能牙刷
summary: Dyson introduced a $499 toothbrush that uses AI and a built-in camera to give real-time feedback. The toothbrush, called CameraJet, is the first with an integrated camera to narrow in on the gaps in the teeth and direct a precision jet at them. Bloomberg's Sam Kelly joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Ternus Takes Apple Helm Ahead of Foldable iPhone Debut
title_cn: 特纳斯 (Ternus) 接掌苹果公司，推出可折叠 iPhone
summary: John Ternus begins his first day as Apple CEO as the company prepares for one of its biggest product launches in years. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman explains how the longtime hardware chief will manage Apple’s veteran leadership team and what to expect from the company’s first foldable iPhone, including a price tag above $2,000. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Can the US AI Boom Survive Data Center Backlash?
title_cn: 美国人工智能热潮能否经受住数据中心的强烈抵制？
summary: Data centers are emerging as an issue in political races across the US as voters raise concerns about power costs and the rapid AI infrastructure buildout. Information Technology Industry Council CEO Jason Oxman discusses the tech industry’s response, growing calls to restrict new projects, and why continued investment is critical to competing with China in AI. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic Says New Fable 5.1 AI Model Is Cheaper, Better at Coding
title_cn: Anthropic 表示新的《神鬼寓言 5.1》人工智能模型更便宜，编码能力更好
summary: Anthropic PBC is releasing a new version of its powerful Fable artificial intelligence model that it says is better at coding and science tasks, as well as more economical — all changes it says are in response to customer feedback.

title: Apple Ternus Touts Product Pipeline, ‘Phenomenal’ Sept. 9 iPhone Launch in Memo
title_cn: Apple Ternus 在备忘录中宣传产品线，“非凡”的 9 月 9 日 iPhone 发布会
summary: Apple Inc. Chief Executive Officer John Ternus touted the company’s strong product pipeline and teased a “phenomenal” iPhone launch next week in his first remarks to employees as their new leader.

title: JPMorgan's Aliaga Is Upbeat on Demand for Big-Tech Debt
title_cn: 摩根大通的阿利亚加对大型科技债务的需求持乐观态度
summary: Big Tech is increasingly turning to debt to finance the massive buildout of AI infrastructure. JPMorgan Asset Management's global market strategist  Stephanie Aliaga explains why hyperscaler bond issuance is poised to keep growing, how the market is absorbing the new supply, and why stronger visibility into AI returns could help sustain the spending boom. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic Signs $35 Billion Pact With Nvidia-Backed Lambda
title_cn: Anthropic 与 Nvidia 支持的 Lambda 签署 350 亿美元协议
summary: Anthropic PBC agreed to a $35 billion computing deal with Lambda, a cloud provider backed by Nvidia Corp., part of an effort to quickly expand its AI capacity, according to a person familiar with the matter.

title: Big Tech Is Incapable of Solving Its Own Problem, Says Mukunda
title_cn: 穆昆达表示，大型科技公司无法解决自己的问题
summary:
Bill Gates, the billionaire co-founder of Microsoft Corp., published a 6,000-word essay on Aug. 26 saying that he would slow the development of artificial intelligence if he could. He elaborated in an interview with the New York Times, saying “in private, people who understand how good this stuff is, and how much better it’s getting, they’re very worried” but few are raising the issues in public.

The public is already convinced the tech industry can’t be trusted with its own creations. Some legal news last week explains why. A bipartisan coalition of 51 attorneys general announced a proposed settlement with Meta Platforms Inc. that obligates the social media company that runs Facebook and Instagram to put tight restrictions on how children use its platforms.

Gautam Mukunda, Lecturer at the Yale School of Management and Bloomberg Opinion contributor, joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple’s Ternus Era Begins After Tim Cook Delivers 2,300% Stock Gain
title_cn: 蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 股价上涨 2,300%，苹果公司的 Ternus 时代开始
summary:
Apple Inc.’s Tim Cook handed over the reins to John Ternus on Tuesday, capping a tenure as chief executive officer that cemented the company as an iconic global brand and turned its stock into one of the most reliable bets.

The shares soared 2,258% under Cook, who took over from legendary founder Steve Jobs after the close of trading on Aug. 24, 2011. Cook inherited a company with a market capitalization of less than $350 billion and built the maker of iPhones and Mac computers into a diverse $4.6 trillion business that also sells watches, AirPods, and financial services.

For more on what lies ahead for both Ternus and the tech giant, we speak with Mark Gurman, Bloomberg News Managing Editor for Global Consumer Tech. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple’s Former CFO Maestri Drops Role Running Corporate Services
title_cn: 苹果前首席财务官马埃斯特里 (Maestri) 不再担任企业服务主管
summary: With John Ternus beginning his role as Apple Inc. chief executive officer this week, another mainstay from the Tim Cook era is dropping his late-career responsibilities.

title: Elon Musk Sees AI Increasing Global Economy by 20%-30%
title_cn: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 认为人工智能将使全球经济增长 20%-30%
summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk says he expects Artificial Intelligence to increase the global economy by 20% - 30%, or roughly $20 Trillion to $30 Trillion, per year. Musk spoke virtually during the G20 Innovation Ministerial. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Is Backstopping AI Ecosystem, Says Araghi
title_cn: 阿拉吉表示，英伟达正在支持人工智能生态系统
summary: Sara Araghi, senior vice president & portfolio manager at Franklin Templeton, says Nvidia is using its financial strength to support an AI ecosystem where demand and monetization remain strong. “You do need Nvidia backstopping some of this to continue to support the ecosystem,” Araghi says on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Robinhood’s Prediction Market Growth Makes Morgan Stanley a Bull
title_cn: Robinhood 预测市场增长让摩根士丹利看好
summary: Robinhood Markets Inc.’s prediction markets efforts offer a “proof point” that the online brokerage can keep expanding revenue, according to Morgan Stanley analyst Michael Cyprys.

title: Airbnb Replaces Business Chief With Ex-Tripadvisor, Booking Exec
title_cn: Airbnb 用前 Tripadvisor、Booking 执行官取代业务主管
summary: Airbnb Inc. has replaced its chief business officer with a former executive of Tripadvisor Inc. and Booking Holdings Inc., underscoring its efforts to expand beyond home-sharing into new travel segments.

title: CEO at Saudi Arabia-Owned Video Game Giant Savvy Steps Down
title_cn: 沙特阿拉伯视频游戏巨头 Savvy 首席执行官辞职
summary: Savvy Games Group Chief Executive Officer Brian Ward, who oversaw the Saudi Arabian government’s $38 billion investment in the video-game industry, is stepping down, according to a message he sent to staff on Tuesday that was reviewed by Bloomberg News.

title: Trump Steps Up New York Immigration Fight With 2,100 Arrests
title_cn: 特朗普加大纽约移民打击力度，逮捕 2,100 人
summary: The Trump administration said it arrested more than 2,100 immigrants across New York in a monthlong operation, intensifying a fight with state and city leaders over their refusal to more closely assist with the federal immigration crackdown.

title: Congress Sends Funding Bill to Avert US Shutdown to Trump
title_cn: 国会向特朗普发送避免美国停摆的资金法案
summary: Congress cleared funding legislation to avert an Oct. 1 government shutdown, sidestepping, at least temporarily, the partisan warfare that led to repeated disruptions over the last year.

title: Kuwait Decree Allows Government to Borrow From Wealth Fund
title_cn: 科威特法令允许政府从财富基金借款
summary: Kuwait’s government has issued a decree allowing it to borrow from its $1 trillion-plus sovereign wealth fund in order to support state finances, as Gulf economies deal with the impact of the US-Iran war.

title: Putin, Xi Discussed Possible APEC Talks With Trump, Russia Says
title_cn: 俄罗斯称普京、习近平与特朗普讨论了可能举行的亚太经合组织会谈

title: US Launches New Iran Strikes as Hormuz Tensions Grow
title_cn: 随着霍尔木兹地区紧张局势加剧，美国对伊朗发动新的打击
summary: The US launched a fresh wave of strikes against targets in Iran, extending a back-and-forth of fighting with neither side prepared to cede control over the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Iran Nuclear Status Unknown With US War Unresolved, IAEA Says
title_cn: 国际原子能机构称，由于美国战争尚未解决，伊朗核状况未知
summary: Iran is continuing to deny international inspectors access to its nuclear facilities, the United Nations atomic watchdog reported, amid little sign that Tehran and Washington are close to finding a way to end their six-month war.

title: Germany Blames Russia for Attempted Drone Attack, Expects More
title_cn: 德国指责俄罗斯未遂无人机袭击，并期待更多
summary: Germany’s government said an investigation found that Russia is behind a failed drone attack at an airport in Leipzig last month and that the Kremlin is likely to step up hybrid aggression.

title: Burnham Says Water Central to UK Plan for Public Control
title_cn: 伯纳姆表示水是英国公共控制计划的核心
summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said the water industry “stands as a leaking monument” to what he sees as the failure of decades of privatization in Britain, pledging to set out a plan for the “public control” of essential services later this year.

title: Surge in UK Borrowing Costs Halves Government’s Fiscal Headroom
title_cn: 英国借贷成本飙升导致政府财政空间减半
summary: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham was confronted by the harsh reality of Britain’s weak public finances on his return to parliament on Tuesday as the global selloff in government bonds left him facing a £12 billion problem.

title: Military Expects UK to Spend 3% of GDP on Defense By 2030
title_cn: 军方预计英国到 2030 年将 GDP 的 3% 用于国防

title: Bessent Says Hormuz Will Be ‘Worthless’ as Oil Bypasses It
title_cn: 贝森特称霍尔木兹将“毫无价值”，因为石油绕过它
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent dismissed the importance of the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, saying the crucial waterway for Persian Gulf energy that’s been controlled by Iran during the recent conflict will be bypassed by oil pipelines.

title: Ukraine Votes Down Tax Bills Required by IMF and EU for Aid

title: Iran Uses Xi-Putin Bloc to Counter US Economic Warfare
title_cn: 伊朗利用习普京集团对抗美国经济战

title: Ukraine Says It Hit Novatek’s Refinery in Russia’s Ust-Luga

summary: Ukraine said its military forces hit a major oil-processing plant in the Baltic port of Ust-Luga, the latest attack in Kyiv’s intensifying campaign against Russia’s energy infrastructure.

title: US Gets Board Veto, Right of First Refusal in Venezuela Deal
title_cn: 美国在委内瑞拉交易中获得董事会否决权和优先购买权
summary: The US detailed plans to exercise greater control over a private operator under a historic deal to seize Venezuela’s oil reserves, including the first option to buy a significant share of its crude production and veto power over board appointments.

title: The Skies Above Mar-a-Lago to Get Permanent Flight Restrictions
title_cn: 海湖庄园上空将受到永久飞行限制
summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration is proposing permanent flight restrictions around President Donald Trump’s Mar-a-Lago Club, while still allowing aircraft arriving or departing from the nearby airport now bearing his name to traverse the airspace.

title: Carney Wins Three More House Seats Amid Trade Fight With US
title_cn: 卡尼在与美国的贸易战中再赢得三个众议院席位
summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney’s Liberals swept three special elections on Monday night, strengthening the Canadian leader’s hand domestically as he defends against President Donald Trump’s tariffs.

title: Xi Returns to Egypt After Decade That Transformed Middle East
title_cn: 改变中东十年后习近平重返埃及
summary: When Chinese President Xi Jinping arrives in Cairo this week, he’ll find plenty has changed in Egypt and the region around it since his last trip to the Middle East’s most populous nation a decade ago.

title: How Iran’s Economy Is Enduring Trump’s War, the US Blockade and Sanctions
title_cn: 伊朗经济如何承受特朗普的战争、美国的封锁和制裁
summary: Iran’s economy was already under strain before the US and Israel launched their war on the Islamic Republic, grappling with negative growth, soaring inflation and a currency crisis. Those problems were compounded by strikes on the nation’s civilian and industrial infrastructure and the US naval blockade of Iranian ports.

title: Former UK Prime Minister Starmer Steps Down From Parliament
title_cn: 英国前首相斯塔默辞去议会职务
summary: Former UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer is leaving British politics after deciding to step down as a member of Parliament.
